en.title: Which File System Should You Use for NAS/Backup and Why?
en.hook: Choosing the right file system can boost performance, reliability, and ease of backup for your NAS—here’s how to decide.
key_takeaways: Compare common NAS file systems (e.g., ext4, XFS, Btrfs) and their trade‑offs.
Consider durability, snapshot support, and compatibility with your workflow.
Best practices for formatting, mounting, and regular backups.

zh.title: NAS/备份应该使用哪种文件系统，为什么？
zh.hook: 正确选择文件系统能提升NAS的性能、可靠性和备份便捷性——教你如何挑选。
key_takeaways: 比较常见NAS文件系统（如ext4、XFS、Btrfs）的优缺点。
考虑数据持久性、快照支持及与工作流的兼容性。
格式化、挂载及定期备份的最佳实践。
